title: Put Down the Poll, Gators. Missouri Is Waiting. And There's A New Definition For 'One Game At A Time'

description: Jon Sumrall wants Gator Nation to put down the poll: Florida has lost three of its last four trips to Columbia, and the coach with the raspy voice is making his team pay the toll on "Bloody Tuesday."

title: Honor Roll: Baugh, Montgomery and Lovett Collect SEC Weekly Awards After Ole Miss Rout
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Jadan Baugh, London Montgomery and Bryce Lovett each won their first SEC weekly honor after Florida's 52-28 win over No. 4 Ole Miss.

creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Jon Sumrall told Florida he doesn't want to hear another word about Ole Miss, and he had good news on Vernell Brown III before Saturday's trip to No. 25 Missouri.

creator: Eddie Gilley
description: Eddie Gilley breaks down the five plays that decided Florida's 52-28 rout of No. 4 Ole Miss, from a blown fourth-down gamble to DJ Coleman's game-sealing interception.

creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Chris Spears had the sideline for all of it. His best photos from The Swamp as Florida ran over No. 4 Ole Miss, 52-28.

title: BREAKING: MRI Confirms Grade 1 PCL Sprain for Gators WR Vernell Brown III
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: An MRI confirmed a Grade 1 PCL sprain, the mildest grade, in Vernell Brown III’s knee, sources told GatorBait. He may not miss any games.

title: Show-Me State of Mind: A First Look at No. 25 Missouri
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: No. 8 Florida’s reward for routing Ole Miss is a trip to No. 25 Missouri, which let a fourth-quarter lead get away at Mississippi State.

title: 10 Thoughts From the Sidelines: Florida 52, Ole Miss 28
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Photographer Chris Spears had the best seat in The Swamp. Ten things the sideline told him about the Florida team that ran over No. 4 Ole Miss.

title: Chomp Up the Charts: Florida Jumps to No. 8 in AP, Coaches Polls
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Florida’s 52-28 win over No. 4 Ole Miss sent the Gators up 13 spots in the AP Top 25 and 14 in the Coaches Poll. They’re No. 8 in both.

title: Bound for the CFB Top Ten: Cue Up “Happy Days Are Here Again”
creator: Buddy Martin
description: Florida’s updated ESPN FPI projections now have the Gators favored in every remaining game except Texas and Georgia. That math comes out to 10-2 and a ticket to the playoff.

title: Postgame Analysis: Florida Gators 52, Ole Miss Rebels 28
creator: Loren Meadows
description: Florida dominated No. 4 Ole Miss for a season-defining win, but Jon Sumrall says the Gators are still a work in progress. Loren Meadows on what he expected, what he got and what comes next.

title: Beating Ole Miss was huge, but the Gators left at least 28 points on the field
creator: Franz Beard
description: Florida beat No. 4 Ole Miss 52-28, but Franz Beard counts at least 28 points the Gators left on the field: an overthrown Vernell Brown III, an open Amir Jackson on fourth down, a 67-yard touchdown erased by a hold, and eight penalties for 92 yards.

title: What Happened in College Football Saturday: Gators Take Down No. 4 Ole Miss as Top 25 Shakes
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Florida beat No. 4 Ole Miss 52-28 to move to 4-0, while Wisconsin and Wake Forest pulled road upsets and No. 1 Texas and No. 2 Georgia stayed unbeaten ahead of Sunday's AP poll.

title: The Swamp Gets Its Swagger Back And Welcomes The Folks From The Grove In Rude Fashion
creator: Buddy Martin
description: Florida 52, Ole Miss 28. Buddy Martin on the Swamp's swagger, Jadan Baugh's historic day, and a 4-0 start for the first time since 2019.

title: Woods Chipper: Florida’s Defense, Special Teams Swing Win Over No. 4 Ole Miss
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Jayden Woods’ strip-sack, an early fourth-down stop and London Montgomery’s kick returns: Florida scored 31 of its 52 points against No. 4 Ole Miss after defensive stops and big returns.

title: ‘It Ain’t Fully Awake Yet’: Sumrall Says Gators Haven’t Arrived After Routing No. 4 Ole Miss
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Jon Sumrall, Jadan Baugh and the Gators after the 52-28 win over No. 4 Ole Miss: Vegas, a broken headset, injury updates on Bailey Stockton and Vernell Brown III, and a beast that is stirring.

title: Contenders, Not Hopefuls: Florida’s Rout of No. 4 Ole Miss Puts the SEC on Notice
creator: Carlton Reese
description: Carlton Reese: With a 52-28 thrashing of No. 4 Ole Miss, Jon Sumrall’s Gators are no longer hoping to compete. They are a legitimate contender.

title: Commit, Then Rout: Four-Star Safety Cyion Smith Picks Florida Before 52-28 Win Over No. 4 Ole Miss
creator: GatorBait Staff
description: Blountstown four-star safety Cyion Smith committed to Florida hours before kickoff, then watched the Gators run over No. 4 Ole Miss 52-28 in The Swamp.
